title: WireGuard Peer Status Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wireguard:peer
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by peer_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when WireGuard peer status data has stopped arriving for a given peer.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per peer and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It gently when one part of your WireGuard peer status feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
